source.license_status: Public Kaggle notebook; reuse still requires preserving attribution and auditing attached dataset licensing.

static_audit.inference: Three-level 3D U-Net detector, XY downsample by four, 20-frame batches, local-max peak extraction and probability thresholding.
static_audit.validation: One fixed movie, custom Hungarian node-recall diagnostic; not embryo-level OOF and not an official pooled tracking score.

discussion_claim: The author reports dense external/FOCUS3D-style pretraining and, separately, edge recall about 0.964 conditional on nodes on one unseen sample, but that claim is not reproduced by the downloaded notebook.
accepted_value: A genuinely different detector family and a possible dense-label pretraining lead. It is not a ready ensemble arm and must not be promoted without acquiring/auditing the attached checkpoint or reproducing training, then running reciprocal embryo-disjoint official full-movie OOF.
decision: Keep as a post-EXP196 detector candidate only if endpoint-limited FN dominates. Do not spend RTX time on it before attribution.
